AC-SE-74's 225 already assumes 126 (125 + 100). D.7 Example 2 says '5000 to below 2500 takes 125 runs'.
findings.fix: AC-SE-23b: 'THEN integrity_bp is exactly SUIT_HP_FAIL (2500) at run 125 and below it first at run 126, and rung 2 is reached while it is still at or above SUIT_HP_FAIL (A7)'. D.7 Example 2: 'reaches 2500 at run 125 and falls below it at run 126'.

findings.section: D.8 A15/A16 (L800), AC-SE-44a (L1719), HOP_LEG_TICKS coupling
findings.finding: leg_runs = ceil((H+75)/6). A16 fires for leg_runs >= 250, i.e. H >= 1420. A15 fails boot when 2*leg_runs > 600, i.e. H >= 1726. The registry owner (Web Map) lists HOP_LEG_TICKS range 360-2190 as legal, so a legal value fails Suit's boot. AC-SE-44a's clause 'HOP_LEG_TICKS 1,500 or more ... boot succeeds with exactly one A16 warning' is false from 1,726 up. The shipped default 900 has +274 runs of slack, so nothing is wrong at defaults. It becomes BLOCKING only if the Web Map pacing spike sets the leg above about 1,725 ticks.
findings.fix: AC-SE-44a: 'GIVEN HOP_LEG_TICKS between 1,420 and 1,725 inclusive, boot succeeds with exactly one A16 warning naming OQ-48 (f); GIVEN 1,726 or more at RESERVE_S 90 and RESERVE_WARN_S 30, boot fails naming A15'. Route to the Web Map owner either to cap HOP_LEG_TICKS_MAX at 1,725 or to state that RESERVE_S must rise with the leg (RESERVE_S >= 30 + ceil(2*leg_runs/10)).

findings.section: Dependencies status paragraph (L1106), Web Map row (L1120), Derelict row (L1136), AC-SE-75c (L1669), AC-SE-34a (L1704), AC-SE-59 (L1737), Gaps (L1761-1762), OQ-30 (L1818), OQ-48 (a)
findings.finding: Stale cross-references. Derelict Authoring has conformed (DA L470, L600, L883-898 cite VACUUM_BUDGET_S and 274 runs, and withdraw RESERVE_S/2), so AC-SE-75c's precondition is met, but Suit still says its text 'still carries the withdrawn bound' and leaves 75c NOT ASSESSED. OQ-30 still states 'every authored vacuum traverse must be at most RESERVE_S / 2' as a live rule, which contradicts D.11, SE-6 and AC-SE-75a. Web Map is POD_RUN, but L1120 says WM-17b and ASK-S2 'still carry the HOLD reading'. Save/Load now has AC-SL-128/129, but 34a still lists their promotion as unconfirmed. The status paragraph is dated round-1 (2026-10-26).
findings.fix: Re-run AC-SE-75c against DA L883 and record PASS or the actual remaining gap. Rewrite OQ-30: 'Cold-room authoring only; the traverse bound is VACUUM_BUDGET_S (D.11).' Update the L1120, L1136, L1704 and L1761-1762 status text. Re-date the status paragraph to the third pass. Move AC-SE-59 off 'Interim NOT ASSESSED' now that every dependent is designed.

findings.section: SE-8 (L194), D.5 sampling note (L723), Edge Cases (L1043), Cross-References (L1500), AC-SE-47a/47b (L1601-1602), OQ-26 (L1814)
findings.finding: Seven places still say BEAM_TOGGLE_MIN_INTERVAL_TICKS is '10 ticks, range 10-20'. The registry owner (Player Controller PC-5) set 12, range 12-20, with a WCAG 2.3.1 floor of 12. AC-SE-47a tests at 10 Hz with the value 10, which is below the legal floor.
findings.fix: Replace '10 ticks, range 10-20' with 'registry value, currently 12, range 12-20' and cite the name only. AC-SE-47a: 'WITH BEAM_TOGGLE_MIN_INTERVAL_TICKS 12'. AC-SE-47b: 'lit span of 12 to 24 ticks'.

findings.section: D.8 'What the table forces' (3) (L844), Tuning Knobs TL_CRITICAL / TL_MAX rows (L1187-1188)
findings.finding: Several published 'safe' ranges fail boot with the other knobs at defaults. Item (3) says TL_MAX cannot fall 'without raising TL_CRITICAL'. That is backwards: A13 needs (TL_MAX - TL_CRITICAL)/TL_GAIN_MAX >= 200 with zero slack, so raising TL_CRITICAL shrinks HOLD_23(warmth). TL_MAX 8000-24000 cites only A4, but A13 pins it at 12000 or more. TL_CRITICAL 4000-8000 gives 100 runs at 8000 and fails A13.
findings.fix: Item (3): 'TL_MAX may not fall unless TL_CRITICAL or TL_GAIN_MAX fall with it (A13), and TL_CRITICAL/TL_GAIN_MAX >= HOLD_12 (A4) limits how far'. Change the knob rows to the A13-feasible region (TL_MAX >= TL_CRITICAL + 200*TL_GAIN_MAX). AC-SE-44b already sweeps these corners.

findings.section: SE-34 (L266), Cross-References, AC-SE-35
findings.finding: SE-34 mirrors SL-15 item 5: a two-phase restore 'returning (ok, reason, detail)'. Kernel CR-19 (a)/(b) (L152-153), as amended by R3, says restore and post_restore report only through ctx and every callable's only return is 'return ctx.complete()'. Failure goes through ctx.fault(code, detail). An implementer reading only Suit gets the signature the kernel forbids. Save/Load SL-15 item 5 has the same residue, so the owner pair is non-conformant too.
findings.fix: Add to SE-34: 'In kernel form (CR-19 (a), R3): restore(data, stored_version, ctx) and post_restore(ctx) end with return ctx.complete(); a SUIT_RESTORE_* reason is reported as ctx.fault(code, detail) with live state untouched'. Route SL-15 item 5 to the Save/Load writer.

findings.section: D.9 PASSIVE fallback line (L858)
findings.finding: The dormant PASSIVE line restates the uncapped credit 'extra_credit = granted_prev - min(granted_prev, pending_draw_mgu)'. D.2 and AC-SE-8d replaced that with the capped form min(granted_prev - bgrant, pending_extra_mgu) because the uncapped form credits from a stale grant. An implementer working from D.9 would rebuild the fixed bug.
findings.fix: Replace the D.9 expression with 'extra_credit per D.2 (capped by pending_extra_mgu)'.

findings.section: R_BREATH range (SE-6 L174, D.2, D.8, Tuning Knobs L1153) vs Item DB
findings.finding: Suit allows R_BREATH 100-600. The Item DB (L1027-1028) fixes port 103 at 1200-1500 and requires 4 x R_BREATH <= the 1500 ceiling, so usable R_BREATH is about 100-375 at MAX_CREW 4. A Suit-legal value of 400-600 fails a downstream BLOCKING lint. AC-SE-49b uses R_BREATH 600 as a fixture. D.8 'RESERVE_MAX_MGU 189,000..1,440,000' is computed from 600.
findings.fix: Narrow the Suit range to 100-375 (or state 'legal only while MAX_CREW x R_BREATH <= the Item DB port-103 ceiling') and give AC-SE-49b/8c a fixture of 375 or 100/200. Registry unit text for R_BREATH should carry the same range.

findings.section: D.10 accessibility rule (2) (L942), L1389 'Every body cue has an audio witness', VA-R6, Audio requirements
findings.finding: The universal claim 'every body cue has an audio witness' is false by Suit's own table: Visor fog and Rime have audio '-', E3 (cold accrual onset, R21) has no audio, and the heat rungs rest on E2. E3 appears only in AC-SE-91a/b and OQ-51. D.10 rule (2) still says the user-accepted exception list is E1 and E2. This weakens the 'tells are honest' promise to a reader of the audio section.
findings.fix: Rewrite L1389 as 'Every body cue has an audio witness that starts no later than its visual, except the declared exceptions E1, E2 and E3 and the visual-only rows (visor fog, rime) whose witness is the breath cadence'. Add E3 to D.10 rule (2) with its delegated-ruling R21 provenance.

findings.section: OQ-11 (L1799); registry STAGGER_WINDOW_TICKS unit text (entities.yaml L9670)
findings.finding: OQ-11 says STAGGER_WINDOW_TICKS 'ships live at MVP', and the registry unit text says 'live at MVP'. SE-35, OQ-38, Tuning Knobs L1218 and D.12 Example 1 all say the trigger is dormant at MVP (it fires on no locked fixture). Suit is the registry source, so the fix is Suit's.
findings.fix: OQ-11: 'registered by the Controller; D.12 is specified and tested on synthetic traces; dormant at MVP (OQ-38)'. Request the registry unit text change to 'dormant at MVP' under Suit as source.

findings.section: SE-30 (L256) vs hud-and-suit-layer.md HS-17 / HSV-7
findings.finding: SE-30 says the reserve reading is 'never seconds, because a seconds readout jumps when the leak starts'. HUD HS-17 draws reserve_seconds = ceil(displayed_pm * RESERVE_S / 1000) and the registry follows that. R8 makes that a legal consumer conversion, but Suit's text reads as a ban, and neither doc says the seconds figure is nominal (it ignores the leak).
findings.fix: SE-30: 'The unit is permille. A consumer may convert to nominal whole seconds (R8, HUD HS-17); that figure is nominal and does not model the leak, so the reserve reading and the seam jet stay the honest check.'

findings.section: Acceptance Criteria preamble (L1528), gate table group D (L1552), Coverage map (L1757), Count line
findings.finding: The criteria count still says 95 numbered criteria (AC-SE-1 to 95). AC-SE-96 and AC-SE-97 (L1623-1624) are absent from the count, the group-D row of the gate table and the coverage map (SE-12 and SE-13 list only 14/79a and 15). The traceability claim is incomplete.
findings.fix: Count: 97. Add 96 and 97 to the group-D row (BLOCKING). Coverage map: 'SE-12: 14, 79a, 96. SE-13: 15, 97. SE-34: add 96.'

findings.section: AC-SE-35 (L1706), SE-38 size (L304), AC-SE-48b (L1753), test infrastructure item (5) (L1555)
findings.finding: Four small oracle defects. (a) The AC-SE-35 fixture ['mod_scrubber',1,5800,6000,S,0] uses a non-int 'S' in a byte-equal round trip. (b) The SE-38 size note (about 330 bytes per seat, under 1.5 KB at four seats) predates the six-element arrays: AC-SE-96 measures 68 bytes for the carried array alone, and a populated seat holds up to three tools, three or more stowed stacks and a carried module, roughly 0.8 KB, so four seats are about 3 KB. (c) AC-SE-48b lacks R12's P99 <= 90 % of ceiling (1.7 ms desktop, 3.3 ms Deck) rule. (d) Test-infra item (5) still owes a reference machine, but R12 named RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK.
findings.fix: (a) Use patched_at_step 0 or a concrete int such as 240. (b) Replace the estimate with 'measured at the spike; provisional ceiling about 3.5 KB at four seats'. (c) Add 'and P99 <= 90 % of the RM ceiling (R12)'. (d) 'Item (5): RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK are defined in project.yaml qa.min_spec'.

findings.finding: The exact valve-click edge counts ('rises by exactly 1 on entry and by exactly 1 on arrival', 'exactly twice') hold only when the seat boards from an AIR_OK room and arrives in one. Boarding from an unbreathable room gives 0 entry edges (already RESERVE), and arriving in an unbreathable room gives 0 disengage edges. No GIVEN states the precondition.
findings.fix: Add to each GIVEN: 'the seat boards from an AIR_OK room (breath_src ROOM) and arrives in one'. Add one negative case: a boarding from an unbreathable room gives 0 entry edges.

findings.section: AC-SE-75a (L1667) vs registry VACUUM_BUDGET_S and DA D.7
findings.finding: AC-SE-75a says the lint 'reads the budget from the exported VACUUM_BUDGET_S' (27 s) but states the bound as 274 runs. The registry exports only the seconds form (floor(274/10) = 27 = 270 runs). DA and Boarding test at 274 runs (DA AC-DA-68 passes at 274 and fails at 275). A lint that reads 27 s literally would fail legal paths of 271-274 runs.
findings.fix: State in D.11/AC-SE-75a that the lint recomputes VACUUM_BUDGET_RUNS from (RESERVE_S - RESERVE_WARN_S)*RUNS_PER_S - 2*leg_runs, and that VACUUM_BUDGET_S is the display form. Or request the registry add VACUUM_BUDGET_RUNS.

findings.section: Sibling residue: emitter-state-and-light-exposure-query.md E4 (L159) and EM-8 (L192); Save/Load SL-15 item 5
findings.finding: Emitter E4 and EM-8 still say bind_beam is called 'by the host session owner at new game through the CR-7 boot step'. Suit SE-9 and AC-SE-11 dropped that wording (kernel CR-7 is the authority model, and the table entry is the CR-7 LOADING rebuild). Emitter's own E9 row was updated, so the Emitter GDD disagrees with itself and with Suit. Not a Suit defect, but Suit is the caller.
findings.fix: Route to the Emitter writer: E4 and EM-8 should read 'by Save/Load's new-game step after create_seat_beam (E9), before the kernel's LOADING rebuild', matching SE-9. Route Save/Load SL-15 item 5 per the SE-34 finding.

findings.section: D.11 Variables (L956, L972)
findings.finding: D.11 now states the intact-suit assumption (gain_at) and leg_runs = N_hi of the slack leg. It still does not say that warmth_ok's tiles are the out-and-back count with no relax credit in DEEP_COLD (the load only accumulates, which is why 96 runs x 40 = 3,840 holds). The Tuning Knobs sink table uses nominal legs (157) while the budget uses slack legs (163), unlabelled.
findings.fix: Add to the tiles row: 'for warmth_ok, out and back inside the room, no relax credit (DEEP_COLD and SCORCH never relax)'. Label the sink-table legs 'nominal; the budget uses the slack leg'.

findings.finding: The criterion says size 'equals the value recorded by the first implementation spike plus 10 %', and until then 'reports the measured size and does not fail'. As written it cannot fail, so it is not testable. The 1,536-byte ceiling in SE-38 is also out of date.
findings.fix: Split it: (i) 'a four-seat maximal block serialises to at most CEILING bytes' with CEILING an explicit data constant (provisional 3,584) that the spike replaces; (ii) 'the value is recorded in production/qa/evidence/'.

findings.section: OQ-49, Tuning Knobs sink/faucet table (L1223-1230)
findings.finding: By the doc's own arithmetic the lamp cell never binds within a sortie (about 4x margin; a full refill is about 4 % of one BATT_CELL), so 'top up now or push on' and the Pillar 3 'go dark' lever are unproven. This is a design-intent question for the playtest, not an edit defect. It stays open and recorded, with metrics (a)-(e).
findings.fix: No edit now. At the first playtest read metrics (a) go-dark frequency and (d) cell-warn crossings. If go-dark is never chosen for light's sake, cut CELL_S first, as the doc already says.

data.summary:
Sixth-pass design review of design/gdd/suit-and-equipment.md. Verdict: APPROVED, 0 BLOCKING. There are 18 RECOMMENDED and 2 NICE items.

This pass changed Suit by one sentence, header item (8). Suit had no file in rr4/blockers/, so none of the roughly 15 carry-over RECOMMENDED items from the last two reviews were touched. For most of them this is the third carry.

I re-derived the load-bearing arithmetic and it holds: the D.1 pod-leg table, D.4 examples 3, 6 and 7, D.8 A3, A5 and A15, the D.11 budget (274 runs; 68 tiles walking, 34 carried, 22 each way), the D.7 thresholds, and AC-SE-21, 22, 24 and 45d. Boarding D.4 agrees with Suit's arrival reserves and budget.

The sibling fixes landed. Derelict Authoring DA-28 now cites VACUUM_BUDGET_S and withdraws RESERVE_S/2. Boarding RESERVE_S is 63-240. Save/Load has AC-SL-128 and AC-SL-129. Web Map is POD_RUN. Suit's own text was not updated to match, so its status text, AC-SE-75c, AC-SE-34a and OQ-30 are stale.

The one new defect from this pass: header item (8) says Web Map quotes VACUUM_BUDGET_S. It does not (0 grep hits, and the registry says so).

The one severity call. AC-SE-18's lint (and the SE-16 'exactly two Suit values' wording) fails a correct implementation, because the Controller Adapter legitimately reads tool_in_hand under G6. It stays RECOMMENDED, because the implementation is right and the test is wrong, but it is ranked first and should be fixed before the Controller story opens.

The next most useful fixes are AC-SE-23b (first run below 2,500 is 126, not 125), the AC-SE-44a/A15 window (A16 warns at 1,420-1,725; A15 fails boot from 1,726), and BEAM_TOGGLE 10 vs the owner's 12.

Nothing here makes the implementation path wrong or impossible. The pod-leg arithmetic, the formulas and the registry defaults are internally consistent.
